summary: Phase 149O.20L.7D.8 -- Class-B Verifier Source Repair Independent Verification. Verification-only (no production verifier/contract source, no Dell mutation, no redeployment, no venv reinstall, no Action-9/REQ-036/CHGR/DeploymentBinding/certification/activation). Independently reconstructed the exact 7D.7 production diff from immutable git objects (8a18f73d..73ea8b23, via a disposable git worktree, never a stash); confirmed zero unrelated production changes across the three verifier modules. Real, executed (not string-inspected) pre-repair reproduction of both defects: distribution lookup genuinely raised PackageNotFoundError/pcae_distribution_metadata_not_found; symlink check genuinely returned unconditional True on a safe Dell-equivalent topology. Repaired code independently confirmed to reach real downstream evidence (both positive and negative directions) for REQ-022/035, and to correctly classify a 12-case adversarial symlink matrix (replacement, target-mutation, target-ancestor, supplementary-group, ACL-only, chained safe/unsafe, broken, loop, relative, inspection-failure) for REQ-030. Caller inventory (14 real call sites) and HMIC v1.3 28-file frozen-authority-bearing-set membership both independently reconstructed via grep/direct import, not trusted from 7D.7's own counts. Full fast_green A/B diff (same .venv interpreter, worktree-baseline pre-repair vs. repaired HEAD): 166 failed/7191 passed/9 errors -> 181 failed/7202 passed/9 errors; 174 common, 16 net-new (15 expected byte-pin/clean-tree assertions plus 1 independently-confirmed, source-independent pre-existing test defect in an unrelated subsystem -- shell_gate.py audit-log state coupling to live REPO_ROOT, reproduced by direct invocation regardless of checked-out commit), 1 resolved (same unrelated subsystem). Zero functional or authority-bearing regressions. Verdict: REGRESSION CLEAN WITH EXPECTED HISTORICAL TEST MIGRATION REQUIRED. Pre/post implementation_scope_digest computed via canonical derive_implementation_scope_digest() and confirmed to differ (b728d368... -> 4e3452ba...), confirming HMIC source-identity change; contract-file bytes independently confirmed unchanged via git diff. Dell's pinned SHA independently confirmed (git merge-base --is-ancestor) to be 68+ commits behind even the pre-repair baseline. Current CHGR chgr-541cb08c313b4f8884970172d37c5a1d independently read and confirmed published before the repair commit, scoped only to the Action-6/Actions-1-5 continuation, and does not authorize deployment of the repaired HEAD. REQ-036 independently reconfirmed OPEN and untouched (_check_launcher byte-identical to phase entry). New independent 28-test companion module (does not import 7D.7's test module as oracle), 3 consecutive clean runs, differential-validity-confirmed against the pre-repair worktree (14 pass / 14 fail, proving the suite genuinely discriminates repair-dependent behavior). Both findings set to INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED REPAIRED IN MAC SOURCE -- NOT YET DEPLOYED. Recommends 149O.20L.7D.9 (redeployment + Action-9 amendment proposition, authority-only, no execution) next; 7E remains blocked.
